title: campanula lusitanica subsp. specularioides
intro: Campanula lusitanica subsp. specularioides, commonly known as the Iberian Bellflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to aid in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its expectorant and mucolytic properties, which can help to relieve congestion and coughs, while its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall health. The bioactive constituents of Campanula lusitanica subsp. specularioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
